name: Invoice Data Extraction API
description:
Upload files, submit an extraction that says in plain words what to extract, wait for it
to finish, and read the rows as JSON or download an XLSX, CSV or JSON file. An extraction
submitted with `options.ask_questions` can stop and ask when the documents leave something
unsettled; the caller answers and the extraction continues.

This document is the contract as the API enforces it. The prose reference, with the same
facts told in order, is https://invoicedataextraction.com/docs/api (Markdown:
https://invoicedataextraction.com/docs/api.md). What changed and when, and how the API is
versioned, is https://invoicedataextraction.com/docs/changelog. A guide for AI agents and the
people directing them is https://invoicedataextraction.com/docs/agents.

Every request may carry `X-SDK-Name` (up to 32 characters) naming the client it comes from,
and `X-SDK-Version` with its version; the official SDKs send `node` and `python`.
